prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent 2x2 expression atlas for Godot cutscenes. No fresh blood, NO red wounds, NO tears from battle, no helmet. All portraits face RIGHT in 3/4 profile. EXACT equal 2x2 grid, character wholly inside each cell with wide transparent gutters and at least 24px outer margin above hair. Same framing and body size. Visible square pixel clusters, fine dithering, rich bronze/navy/crimson shadows as first reference; NOT smooth illustration, NOT chibi. Top-left calm focused leadership, closed mouth and firm eyes. TRUE transparent alpha background. No scenery, no baked checkerboard, no text, no labels, no frames, never overlap cells.
